context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock solid for cousin.artisan + cousin.admin flows. Use /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_frontend_nonregression.py as the canonical fast regression suite (3s) before/after any frontend-only change. To run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_smoke_frontend_nonregression.py -v --no-cov`. The --no-cov flag is needed because pytest.ini enforces 80% coverage which a 7-endpoint smoke can't reach.
